rationale:
Evidence. Iteration 8 (y = 0.065 m, score 431.1, best raced) is the reference. Its oval is now 20/20 finishes (mean score 944, progress 0.998). The s-bend and slalom still end 20/20 off track. S-bend max_error is 0.0622, just past the 0.06 m limit, and its progress is 0.63. Slalom max_error is 0.0654 with 1.0 line-loss events. The oval score is close to its ceiling, so the remaining points are in the s-bend and slalom finishes, which are worth 500 each. Those failures are overshoot on bends, which points to too much speed for the bend gain and damping rather than to sensing.

Change. base_speed goes from 1.2 to 1.1. Geometry is kept at y = 0.065 m, span x = -0.07 to 0.07, sensor_size 0.016, and the body, wheel and mass values. Controller is kept at kp 2.6, ki 0.1, kd 0.6, the sensor_weights and line_loss last_direction. This is a single-variable test from the best raced design.

Deviation from the Evaluator's line-loss rule. The rule says to return y to 0.05 if line_loss_events exceeds about 0.3. At y 0.065, oval line loss rose from 0.15 to 0.65 and slalom sits at 1.0. Slalom was already 0.8 at y 0.05, so most of the rise is in the oval. The line-loss term is worth only about 10 points on the oval at this level, while y 0.065 gave the best score. I am keeping y 0.065 and testing speed, and I will return y to 0.05 if the next race shows a clear loss.

Expected result. Less speed means less lag and less overshoot at the bends, so s-bend max_error should fall under 0.06 and some s-bend finishes should appear, worth +500 each. Oval finishes should stay at 17/20 or better. Oval completion time will rise a little (about 2.1 s), costing roughly 7 points per oval run. Risk: if the s-bend stays off track at 1.1, speed is not the limit and the next step is kd 0.5 at y 0.065.

Hypotheses to check next: (a) s-bend max_error falls below 0.06 and at least some s-bend finishes appear; (b) oval finishes stay at 20/20 or near it; (c) line_loss_events stay near the iteration 8 levels. If the s-bend is clean at 1.1, the next lever is base_speed 1.2 with kd 0.5, not a faster speed.
